sup:70710.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
We appreciate the transparency on the cost pressures and the planning certainty of our long relationship, and understand the value of the fixed-price material you bought forward. Our order would cover our full demand for this part over the contract term, with a rising forecast, giving you both volume certainty and a longer planning horizon; could you review the base price and alloy surcharge in light of that commitment and share how you arrived at them?

Your letter of 2026-07-06 (doc:20260706-70710-M1) says your material is covered at fixed prices, so recent index movements do not reach your costs yet.
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 5.45 (po:4500014455-10, po:4500014391-10, po:4500014305-10).
In our call of 2026-04-21 (doc:20260421-70710-M2) you offered to walk us through your calculation; we would welcome that now.

On this basis we propose: EUR 4.76 per unit, fixed price, payment 90 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 94800 units a year over 36 months.

Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we understand the drivers together?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.

We appreciate your commitment to a 36-month contract and the volume certainty it brings. While we can accommodate the 90-day payment terms, we cannot offer a fixed price over 36 months and must include an AS-14404 index clause. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

Our present Angebot stands at a price of €5.45 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Based on these terms, we can offer a revised price of EUR 5.57 per unit. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.57 per unit, with a price of €5.57 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your reply and for the step you have taken; we appreciate it.
Thank you for reviewing our proposal and for moving your offer; we appreciate that, and understand your need to account for material costs and the limits on sharing your calculation. Our fixed full demand for this part over the contract term, the planning security of a long-term agreement, and our rising forecast provide a strong basis for working toward terms that reflect our commitment. We are moving toward you again in our proposal and would welcome the calculation walkthrough your owner previously offered, to help us understand how the cost drivers are applied.

Our forecast for this part is up 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).

On this basis we propose: EUR 4.82 per unit, price follows AS-14404 on 45% of the price, deadband 0.0%, payment 90 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 94800 units a year over 36 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
